title: gRPC and Reactive Kafka Fails Native Build
body:
**Describe the bug**
When running native build with Gradle and JIB on a project containing both `quarkus-smallrye-reactive-messaging-kafka` and `quarkus-grpc`, native build fails with class initialization time error.

**Expected behavior**
Native build completes successfully.

**Actual behavior**
Native build fails with the following stacktrace:

```
Error: Classes that should be initialized at run time got initialized during image building:
 io.netty.channel.epoll.Epoll the class was requested to be initialized at run time (from feature io.quarkus.runner.AutoFeature.beforeAnalysis). io.netty.channel.epoll.Epoll has been initialized without the native-image initialization instrumentation and the stack
trace can't be tracked. Try avoiding to initialize the class that caused initialization of io.netty.channel.epoll.Epoll

com.oracle.svm.core.util.UserError$UserException: Classes that should be initialized at run time got initialized during image building:
 io.netty.channel.epoll.Epoll the class was requested to be initialized at run time (from feature io.quarkus.runner.AutoFeature.beforeAnalysis). io.netty.channel.epoll.Epoll has been initialized without the native-image initialization instrumentation and the stack
trace can't be tracked. Try avoiding to initialize the class that caused initialization of io.netty.channel.epoll.Epoll

        at com.oracle.svm.core.util.UserError.abort(UserError.java:68)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.classinitialization.ConfigurableClassInitialization.checkDelayedInitialization(ConfigurableClassInitialization.java:526)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.classinitialization.ClassInitializationFeature.duringAnalysis(ClassInitializationFeature.java:227)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.NativeImageGenerator.lambda$runPointsToAnalysis$8(NativeImageGenerator.java:732)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.FeatureHandler.forEachFeature(FeatureHandler.java:70)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.NativeImageGenerator.runPointsToAnalysis(NativeImageGenerator.java:732)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.NativeImageGenerator.doRun(NativeImageGenerator.java:555)
        at com.oracle.svm.hosted.NativeImageGenerator.lambda$run$0(NativeImageGenerator.java:468)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinTask$AdaptedRunnableAction.exec(ForkJoinTask.java:1407)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinTask.doExec(ForkJoinTask.java:290)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool$WorkQueue.topLevelExec(ForkJoinPool.java:1020)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.scan(ForkJoinPool.java:1656)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.runWorker(ForkJoinPool.java:1594)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinWorkerThread.run(ForkJoinWorkerThread.java:183)
Error: Image build request failed with exit status 1
```


**To Reproduce**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a project based on the quickstart for gRPC
2. Add the `quarkus-container-image-jib` dependency
3. Run `./gradlew build -Dquarkus.package.type=native -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true`
4. Observe image builds successfully
5. Add the `quarkus-smallrye-reactive-messaging-kafka` dependency
6. (Optional) Add a stream according to the Quarkus documentation
7. Attempt a native build with the command `./gradlew clean build -Dquarkus.package.type=native -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true`
8. Observe the failure indicated above

**Configuration**
```properties
quarkus:
  native:
    additional-build-args: -H:+TraceClassInitialization
```

**Screenshots**

N/A

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`: Windows 10
 - Output of `java -version`: 
```
openjdk version "11.0.8" 2020-07-14 LTS
OpenJDK Runtime Environment 18.9 (build 11.0.8+10-LTS)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM 18.9 (build 11.0.8+10-LTS, mixed mode)
```
 - GraalVM version (if different from Java): 20.2.0 (quay.io/quarkus/ubi-quarkus-native-image:20.2.0-java11)
 - Quarkus version or git rev: 1.8.1.Final
 - Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`): Gradle 6.6.1

**Additional context**
N/A
